content: HERODES NUG LAYAṮAK JOHANES BAG OTAḎOM
Haen amup̱a Herodes Antipas nug Jesus onig binag ele doyom.
Doya amu nuhiḵud uḏat danab amelagp̱a aum. “Danab amuam Layaṯak Johanes mauhowa, eḏua hibaiṯom amunu g̱agaṯag oḵai oḵai amu nuhigp̱a beṯe,” awa aum.

Amu diig am Herodes Antipas nug amag Pilipus wau Herodias awe, Johanes nug Herodes amegp̱a, “Na awan wau aome, amup̱a na ḏo tip̱alme, kobol amuam ena iiṯa,” aum amunu Herodes nug Johanes ep̱eg hip̱ala, mani guiṯakp̱a meum.
Amu nug Johanes qeeb mauhḵunu heum amge nug danab ah dilag baḏom. Aḏinu? Danab ah ag Johanesnu, “Nug am Kayaknu propet,” aon ap̱ig.
Anam dayom amge Herodes Antipas menuak deḏp̱a, Herodias aḏeg amu ḏo danab kuḏum noolagp̱a ahi goḏe, Herodes nug iṯag qeum
amunu nug nai qaḵa, nug nid ahin keeke aḏi laa aoḵunu ab amu medaḵununab aum.
Nid ahin amu anig nug dab mak meṯom amunu nug aum. “Na Layaṯak Johanes baag otaḏna, iḵi tap̱iḏp̱a mena, haen imup̱a meḏaḵut,” awa aum.

Nid ahin nug anam a amu king Herodes nug oo ug ele dayom amge nug nai nuhig g̱agaṯag qa aawo, ḏo danab ag nug ele e lap̱ig amu ag ele nai amu doop̱ig amunu nug aum. “Layaṯak Johanes iḵi tap̱iḏp̱a mena, aon dona meṯeg!”
anana amu nug he, uḏat danab laa nug uḵa, Johanes baag otaḏom.
Bag otaḏe amu ag nug iḵi tap̱iḏp̱a mena, nid ahin medap̱ig. Nid ahin meṯaeg amu nid ahin nug awa uḵa, anig meṯom.
Layaṯak Johanesnu ip̱uniṯak awak danab ag nai doona uḏin, Johanes gaḏa aon gona boomp̱ig. Ip̱uniṯak awak danab ag Johanes boomona, ag gona, Jesus amegp̱a ap̱ig.
JESUS DANAB 5000 E MAṮOM
Jesus nai amu doya, Nug aben amu uua, ub awa, aben danab ii daaṯeb, ap̱a goḵunu uḵom. Nug anam ugeḵe amu danab ah ag nai doona, ag ab ohp̱anu ahan, Jesus ugeḵe, ag baelagp̱a Nug dim lamidna gop̱ig.
Ag anam heegeg, Jesus uḵa eeḏa amu danab ah ameg naḏi ag Nug ameg mena daaegeg anaṯom. Nug anam anaṯa amu oo doye, ahilḵad danab ah oḏe ele amu bap̱alaṯom.

Bap̱alaṯeṯe, tueb me, nuhig ip̱uniṯak awak danab ag Jesus gumidna dona amegp̱a ap̱ig. “Laih imu am aben danab ii daaṯeb. Aam ele uḵa noṯe amunu danab ah ameg naḏi imu amelagp̱a ap̱e, ag ab ab gona, e daden mena laig!” aon ap̱ig.
Ip̱uniṯak awak danab ag anam aeg amu Jesus Nug aum. “Aḏinu da ap̱i goḵulagnu aṯeb? Ag e madap̱eg laig!”
Nug anam a amu ag amegp̱a ap̱ig. “Amge ig ip̱a e kuḏum laa iiṯa, bret kunum tanig ele amu kakai aḏit eleib daaṯe,” aon ap̱ig.
Anam aeg amu Nug aum. “Aḵan dona, da meḏeg!” awa aum.

Anana amu Nug danab ah ameg naḏi, ag amelagp̱a, “Ag gikiḏahp̱a dayeg!” anana amu Nug bret tanig ele amu kakai aḏit ele amu diia aḏa, hab aṯan neeḵaḵa unuqiṯom. Unuqiṯowa amu pane ne, nuhiḵud ip̱uniṯak awak danab maṯe, ip̱uniṯak awak danab ag diin panin, danab ah madap̱ig.
Maṯaeg amu danab ah ag e amu laeg, oolag diṯie, e big dayom amu ip̱uniṯak awak danab ag aon, kaleg tuelp inaeg, am beum.
Danab e lap̱ig ele amu 5,000 anam. Ah nid naunau ele amu eb qak amu oop̱a ii daaṯeb, danabib eb aqap̱ig.
JESUS NUG BAEGP̱A LE GAḎAP̱A UḴOM
Ag e lana malaeg amu Jesus Nug nuhiḵud ip̱uniṯak awak danab ag amelagp̱a aum. “Da danab ah imu oh qatiglagnu abip̱i, ag ahan ubp̱a tena, Galelia le mataḏna, laih uḵeg!” awa aum.
Nug anam a amu ag ahan uḵaegeg, Jesus Nug danab ah amelagp̱a, “Enad uḵe,” awowa, Nug nuḵa amu unuqidḵunu qaukop̱a uḵom. Tueb amup̱a amu Nug nuḵa qauko amup̱a dayom.
Qaukop̱a dayeye amu ub uḵa, le ameg gamagp̱a wa, ulah naḏi ha, duban ub qe, ulah ub nob awe, eḏua laih goḵunu heum.
Anam he uḵe, waḵaḏeḏe Jesus le gaḏa tap̱a, nuhiḵud ip̱uniṯak awak danab gumaṯa uḏiom.
Ip̱uniṯak awak danab ag Jesus le gaḏap̱a tap̱a uḏieye anidna, oṯaina, “Umu am doṯog,” anana, oolag baḏe huanak ep̱ig.
Huanak eeg amu Jesus Nug pahanab amelagp̱a aum. “Ag g̱agaṯag dayeg! Ag aib baḏap̱ig. Imu daib,” awa aum.
Jesus anam a amu Petrus nug Jesus oḏep̱a awa, inam aum. “Naḏi, genab na daaṯem dayeb amu na ap̱e, da ub uuen, na gumiṯe waḵul,” awa aum.
Petrus anam a amu Jesus aum. “Na do!”, awa aum. Nug anam a amu Petrus nug ub uua noa, Jesus gumiṯa waum.
Nug anam wanana amu ulah huanak heehe anṯa baḏa, le oop̱a noḵunu ha, Jesus onigp̱a ewa aum. “Naḏi na da ehaniḏe!” awa aum.
Petrus anam a amu pahanab Jesus ep̱eg bahia, Petrus aḏa amu amegp̱a aum. “Na ootp̱a nakokib genab dooṯem. Aḏinu na dab mak aḏit ele?”
Jesus Nug anam Petrus amegp̱a a, a ub aṯan oolya teeh amu ulah to eṯom.
Ulah to eṯe, ub aṯan daap̱ig ele amu ag Jesus noobp̱a dup nona, binag mena ap̱ig. “Genab na am Kayak beḵa,” aon ap̱ig.
Jesus beḵod ele ag ub aṯan gona, le mataḏna Genesaret ihip̱a eeḏp̱ig.
Eeḏna teeg amu danab ap̱anu ag doop̱ig, am Jesus, amunu ag nai meeg, ab taliliak amu ohp̱a uḵe doona, oḏe danab oh diin, Jesus top̱a uḏip̱ig.
Uḏina ag oḏe danab Jesusnu lamen daugib aḏaglagnu unuqidp̱ig. Unuqidna, danab ag anam hep̱ig ele, amu oh ag beḏulag ena dayom.
